_about: Shops and services in and around Farley Commercial Centre, Jalan Salim, Sibu, compiled 26 Sep 2026 from the owner's Google Earth Street View recordings (imagery dated Oct 2024 / Mar 2025 unless noted) and public listings. Street View is almost two years old: every entry with verify_before_launch=true must be checked on site or with the owner before it appears on the live page. Use shop names as plain text only - never reproduce their logos.
